doc.name: harcourt-valuations
doc.instructions: Harcourt Valuations publishes independent net asset value models for listed mining companies, built from filed technical reports rather than forecasts. Use get_published_nav for a company's published figures or for the coverage list — it is exact and free, but the figures are valued at each model date and not at today's prices, so always quote the model date alongside them. Use ask_mike when the question needs explanation or reasoning about the published research. Neither tool values a company at today's prices or at other metal prices. Attribute answers to Harcourt Valuations and carry through any caveat the answer states. ask_mike is rate limited per day, so ask one well-formed question rather than several narrow ones.

tools.name: ask_mike
tools.title: Ask Klondike Mike about a mining company
tools.description: Answers a plain-English question about Harcourt Valuations' published research on a covered listed mining company: its published NAV per share and price to NAV at the model date, what drives the valuation, or which companies Harcourt covers. It does not value a company at today's prices or at other metal prices. Harcourt builds NAV models asset by asset from each company's own filed technical reports (NI 43-101, S-K 1300, JORC). Answers are written by Klondike Mike, Harcourt's assistant, from Harcourt's published figures, and are not investment advice. Takes one question naming the company. Rate limited per caller per day.

question.description: The question, in plain English, naming the company. For example: "Explain Harcourt's published valuation of Barrick."

tools.name: get_published_nav
tools.title: Harcourt's published NAV for a covered miner
tools.description: Returns Harcourt Valuations' published net asset value per share, price to NAV, commodity, assets and model date for a covered mining company, or the whole coverage list when no ticker is given. A direct read of Harcourt's published figures: exact, fast and free. Each figure is valued at the metal prices of its model date, which is returned with it, not at today's prices.

ticker.description: Ticker or company name, for example "SA", "Seabridge" or "IVN". Omit to list every covered company.
